facts_of_case: Parties were married in 2017. A girl child was born out of this wedlock. Petitioner-wife is living separately from respondent-husband since 02.3.2018 and seeking maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: In matrimonial matters, wherever Courts are called upon to consider the plea of transfer, the Courts have to take into consideration the economic soundness of both the parties, the social strata of the spouses and their behavioural pattern, their standard of life prior to the marriage and subsequent thereto and the circumstances of both the parties in eking out their livelihood.
